summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` (~727 KB) that is heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style transformations (hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, per-function string-map indirection objects, a shuffled numeric/string constant pool, and a string-array rotation function `WV8StW`). Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` use the same obfuscation style. The package advertises itself as a React component kit; that stated purpose does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque install-time payload. The design — dropping a non-Node runtime and executing an obfuscated blob under it at `npm install` time — evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code and yields arbitrary code execution on every installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
